Simpra Docs ​

Welcome to the Simpra documentation. This guide covers platform setup, architecture, feature usage, and API reference.

What is Simpra ​

Simpra is a modern inventory and warehouse platform for managing stock, warehouses, suppliers, purchasing, and analytics in one place.

Sections ​

  • Getting Started — setup, installation, and local development
  • Architecture — clean architecture, monorepo structure, and tech stack
  • Deployment — deploy FE to Vercel and docs to Vercel
  • Features — inventory, warehouses, stock, purchasing, suppliers, analytics
  • API — authentication, endpoints, and integration
